import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def nki_attention_(q, k, v):
    seq_len, dim = q.shape
    # Allocate output buffer
    out = nl.ndarray((seq_len, dim), dtype=q.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    # Allocate sbuf for intermediate results
    sbuf = nl.ndarray((seq_len, dim), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    # Allocate psum for matmul
    psum = nl.ndarray((seq_len, dim), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.psum)
    
    # Copy q to sbuf
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=sbuf, src=q)
    
    # Compute scores = q @ k.T / sqrt(d)
    nisa.nc_matmul(dst=psum, stationary=sbuf, moving=k)
    nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=psum, data=1.0 / (dim ** 0.5), op0=nisa.multiply)
    
    # Compute scores - scores.max(axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    # Use tile to compute max
    tile = nl.ndarray((seq_len, dim), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=psum)
    max_vals = nl.ndarray((seq_len, 1), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    for i in nl.affine_range(seq_len):
        max_vals[i, 0] = nl.sum(tile[i, :], axis=[1])
    nisa.tensor_copy(dst=psum, src=tile)
    nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=psum, data=max_vals, op0=nisa.subtract)
    
    # Compute e = exp(scores)
    nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=psum, data=0.0, op0=nisa.exp)
    
    # Compute e / e.sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    # Compute sum of e

    for i in nl.affine_range(seq_len):

    # Normalize

    nisa.nc_matmul(dst=psum, stationary=psum, moving=v)
    nisa.tensor_copy(dst=sbuf, src=psum)

import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def nki_attention_(q, k, v):
    seq_len, dim = q.shape
    # Allocate output buffer
    out = nl.ndarray((seq_len, dim), dtype=q.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    # Allocate temporary buffers
    q_tile = nl.ndarray((128, dim), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    k_tile = nl.ndarray((128, dim), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    v_tile = nl.ndarray((128, dim), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    scores_tile = nl.ndarray((128, seq_len), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.psum)
    exp_tile = nl.ndarray((128, seq_len), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.psum)
    weights_tile = nl.ndarray((128, seq_len), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.psum)
    
    # Copy q to sbuf
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=q_tile, src=q)
    # Copy k to sbuf
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=k_tile, src=k)
    # Copy v to sbuf
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=v_tile, src=v)
    
    # Compute scores = Q @ K.T / sqrt(d)
    for i in nl.affine_range(128):
        for j in nl.affine_range(seq_len):
            for k_idx in nl.affine_range(dim):
                scores_tile[i, j] += q_tile[i, k_idx] * k_tile[j, k_idx]
    nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=scores_tile, data=0.5, op0=nisa.multiply)
    
    # Compute row max
    max_vals = nl.ndarray((128, 1), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    for i in nl.affine_range(128):
        max_vals[i, 0] = scores_tile[i, :].max()
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=max_vals, src=max_vals)
    
    # Subtract row max
    for i in nl.affine_range(128):
        for j in nl.affine_range(seq_len):
            scores_tile[i, j] -= max_vals[i, 0]
    
    # Compute exp(scores)
    for i in nl.affine_range(128):
        for j in nl.affine_range(seq_len):
            exp_tile[i, j] = nisa.exp(scores_tile[i, j])
    
    # Compute exp_sum = exp(scores).sum(axis=-1)
    exp_sum = nl.ndarray((128, 1), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.psum)
    for i in nl.affine_range(128):
        exp_sum[i, 0] = exp_tile[i, :].sum()
    
    # Compute weights = exp / exp_sum
    for i in nl.affine_range(128):
        for j in nl.affine_range(seq_len):
            weights_tile[i, j] = exp_tile[i, j] / exp_sum[i, 0]
    
    # Compute output = weights @ v
    for i in nl.affine_range(128):
        for j in nl.affine_range(dim):
            for k_idx in nl.affine_range(seq_len):
                out[i, j] += weights_tile[i, k_idx] * v_tile[k_idx, j]
    
    # Copy result to shared HBM
    nisa.tensor_copy(dst=out, src=out)
    return out

import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def nki_attention_(q, k, v):
    seq_len, dim = q.shape
    # Allocate output buffer
    out = nl.ndarray((seq_len, dim), dtype=q.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    # Allocate temporary buffers
    q_tile = nl.ndarray((128, dim), dtype=q.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    k_tile = nl.ndarray((128, dim), dtype=k.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    v_tile = nl.ndarray((128, dim), dtype=v.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    scores_tile = nl.ndarray((128, 128), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.psum)
    exp_tile = nl.ndarray((128, seq_len), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    sum_tile = nl.ndarray((128, 1), dtype=nl.float32, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    # Copy q, k, v to sbuf
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=q_tile, src=q)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=k_tile, src=k)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=v_tile, src=v)
    # Compute scores = q @ k.T / sqrt(d)
    for i in nl.affine_range(128):
        nisa.nc_matmul(dst=scores_tile[:, i], stationary=k_tile[i, :], moving=q_tile[:, i])
        nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=scores_tile[:, i], data=0.5, op0=nisa.multiply)
    # Compute scores - scores.max(axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    for i in nl.affine_range(128):
        max_val = nl.sum(scores_tile[i, :], axis=[0])
        scores_tile[i, :] = scores_tile[i, :] - max_val
    # Compute exp(scores)
    for i in nl.affine_range(128):
        for j in nl.affine_range(seq_len):
            exp_tile[i, j] = nisa.exp(scores_tile[i, j])
    # Compute exp / exp.sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    for i in nl.affine_range(128):
        sum_val = nl.sum(exp_tile[i, :], axis=[1])
        exp_tile[i, :] = exp_tile[i, :] / sum_val
    # Compute exp @ v
    for i in nl.affine_range(128):
        nisa.nc_matmul(dst=out[i, :], stationary=v_tile[i, :], moving=exp_tile[i, :])
    # Copy result to shared_hbm
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=out, src=out)
    return out

    nisa.nc_matmul(dst=psum, stationary=k, moving=sbuf)
